lines.speaker: Stella
lines.text: For fuck's sake, Marco. You go out at night to relax and instead you have to sit through a Fellucci lecture outside school hours...

lines.speaker: Stella
lines.text: And anyway, sorry, but what was any of that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Stella
lines.text: The river stays a river, then it touches the sea and becomes the sea.

lines.speaker: Stella
lines.text: What's there to wonder about, exactly?
